en: Hebrews 3

p.src: 1  Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

en: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
u.src: 1  Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

p.src: 2  who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

en: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.
u.src: 2  who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

p.src: 3  For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

en: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
u.src: 3  For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

p.src: 4  For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

en: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.
u.src: 4  For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

p.src: 5  Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

en: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
u.src: 5  Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

p.src: 6  but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

en: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
u.src: 6  but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

en: 3:6 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.

p.src: 7  Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

en: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,
u.src: 7  Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

p.src: 8  don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

en: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
u.src: 8  don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

p.src: 9  where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

en: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.
u.src: 9  where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

p.src: 10  Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

en: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’
u.src: 10  Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

p.src: 11  As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

en: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”
u.src: 11  As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

p.src: 12  Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

en: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;
u.src: 12  Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

p.src: 13  but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

en: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
u.src: 13  but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

p.src: 14  For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

en: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
u.src: 14  For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

p.src: 15  while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

en: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
u.src: 15  while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

p.src: 16  For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

en: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?
u.src: 16  For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

p.src: 17  With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

en: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

p.src: 18  To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

en: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
u.src: 18  To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

p.src: 19  We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

en: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.
